# Contributing

## Issues
Please use the issue templates provided.

## Pull-requests
Please make PRs from your fork to the **`dev`** branch of this repo.  
> If approved, it will then be tested, then if accepted and successful, your contribution will be merged into `main`.

## Security
**If urgent**, please send an email to test[at]example(dot)org.  
Otherwise please send a PR with details, or open an issue.
